cw_churchwarden.text: St Edward's. Look up at the roof and the great windows; the wool merchants paid for all this and we are still thanking them. You could say every stone of it has a sheep somewhere in the accounts.
Outside, the north door sits between two ancient yews. They look like two guardians, and some say Tolkien had them in mind for the doors of Moria. We don't make any claims. We just stand them well.
